A little
about me.

I’m a fourth-year Software Engineering student at Metropolitan University, Sylhet.

I enjoy working through programming problems and figuring out why a solution works. Building web applications gives me a way to put that thinking into practice.

Coding agents are part of how I work. I use them alongside my own understanding of the code, review the output and connect development tools where they help the task.

Outside programming, I read books, play games and explore new apps. I’m interested in AI and automation, and I’m also working on game projects.
